display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-07 Concentrated solar thermal systems for decarbonising industrial processes – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-07 Concentrated solar thermal systems for decarbonising industrial processes
executive_summary: A Horizon Europe Innovation Action, funded as a lump sum, to demonstrate concentrated solar thermal systems with storage that supply heat at 150 to 400°C to existing industrial processes, reaching a yearly solar fraction of at least 50% and TRL 7, with at least six months of continuous demonstration. Standard Horizon Europe consortium rules apply, and entities controlled by China or by a legal entity established in China are excluded. The topic budget is EUR 12 million for around two projects of about EUR 6 million each, funded at up to 70% (100% for non-profit entities). Single-stage; opens 3 December 2026, deadline 31 March 2027 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme 2026-2027 (Part 8), pp. 127–129, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds the demonstration of concentrated solar heat with storage feeding industrial heating or cooling processes, with the core solution on the solar thermal part. It does not touch TenneT's field: no project file is close to it, and the topic supplies on-site renewable heat rather than electricity, without any grid connection, electrification or flexibility task.
